display_information.name: Outreach Finance
display_information.description: Ask about your outreach budget and log receipts, straight into the FFSA Hub.
display_information.long_description: The FFSA Hub's outreach finance helper. Direct message is the default. A private team channel also works. Send a receipt photo first: the bot reads it, names the budget line in plain words, and waits for Confirm before anything is sent to Xero. A purchase with no receipt is repaid by the person who spent the money — it is not put on the budget. It only ever sees your own team's budget.
